## 🚀 What Happens When User Clicks

1. **User searches**: "buy BO7 account California"
2. **Google shows result**: BattleGaming in position #3-5 (after 6+ months)
3. **User clicks**: CTR improvement due to click-magnet title
4. **Page loads**: Vercel CDN serves in <100ms
5. **Content displays**: Next.js renders server-side with fresh data from Supabase
6. **User sees**:
   - Verified BattleGaming branding
   - Account details (game, platform, wins)
   - Regional benefits highlighted
   - Trust signals (24/7 support, warranty)
   - Pricing ($59.99)
   - Clear CTA (Order/Checkout button)
7. **User converts**: Clicks "Order Now" → Checkout flow
